endorsements.label: Half Measures and Full Compromise: Exploiting Microsoft Exchange PowerShell Remoting
endorsements.description: Microsoft Exchange Server is a popular mail server, both with enterprises and attackers. As a compromise of Exchange leads to the exfiltration of confidential data, it has a long story of abuse and it is frequently targeted by nation-state actors. Read more
